recipes.description: Create a WordPress instance with its managed database, persistent files, health checks, and an LMS local access route.
recipes.baseRecipePrompt: Set up a private WordPress website with persistent site files and an LMS-managed database. Use the supported defaults unless I specify a WordPress version, variant, database choice, database administration tool, domain, or other requirement below.
recipes.technicalGuidance: Keep WordPress and its database on the private LMS deployment network. Verify the database dependency before reporting the website ready.

recipes.description: Create a private forward proxy for devices on networks you control and verify the proxy listener without publishing an internet-facing admin page.
recipes.baseRecipePrompt: Set up a private forward proxy for devices on networks I control. Keep it private unless I explicitly describe a trusted network or access requirement.
recipes.technicalGuidance: Treat this as a private network service. Do not expose it through Edge Gateway or configure it as an open public proxy.

recipes.description: Set up Webtor and Stremio behind one reusable VPN Gateway, with LMS-managed local access and streaming connectivity.
recipes.baseRecipePrompt: Set up Webtor and Stremio behind an existing VPN Gateway with LMS-managed local access. Ask me which gateway to use if there is more than one.
recipes.technicalGuidance: Preserve trusted local Caddy access, Webtor HTTP cookie rewriting, separate internal ports in the shared VPN namespace, and the Stremio-to-host gateway mapping used for local Webtor streams. This is for personal, public-domain, or otherwise lawfully accessed content; do not configure content sources or add-ons.

recipes.description: Set up qBittorrent behind an existing reusable VPN Gateway and verify that its traffic cannot bypass the gateway.
recipes.baseRecipePrompt: Set up qBittorrent behind an existing VPN Gateway, store downloads in my LMS Home Lab storage, and verify that its traffic cannot bypass the gateway.
recipes.technicalGuidance: Do not require inbound port forwarding: it is optional and some VPN providers support P2P without it. Preserve the trusted local LMS Caddy route and its first-open referrer handling.

recipes.recipeName: qBittorrent and media automation through VPN
recipes.description: Set up qBittorrent, Prowlarr, Sonarr, Radarr, and Seerr behind one reusable VPN Gateway.
recipes.baseRecipePrompt: Set up qBittorrent, Prowlarr, Sonarr, Radarr, and Seerr behind one existing VPN Gateway. Reuse my LMS Home Lab storage and ask before making any choice that depends on my environment.
recipes.technicalGuidance: Route every requested service through the selected gateway and preserve a distinct internal listener for each web interface. Use the shared VPN namespace loopback endpoints when describing app-to-app connections. Do not select, recommend, or configure indexers, catalogues, download sources, or content. The user completes any source-specific configuration for services they are authorised to use.

recipes.description: Set up Immich and its managed database, cache, and machine-learning dependencies for a private photo and video library.
recipes.baseRecipePrompt: Set up a private Immich photo and video library with persistent storage and its LMS-managed database, cache, and machine-learning services. Ask me about storage or access requirements that are not already configured.
recipes.technicalGuidance: Verify every managed Immich dependency and the LMS local access route before reporting the library ready.
